doc: OFFLINE ADAPTER DECLARATION for the account_return_daily of ONE custody source, keyed by the custody master the registry derives the firm from (C-ADAPTERS). Same law as data/assets/scripts/gold/irpt_reporting/sources.json: one entry per custody source, vendor codes only inside their own adapter, no firm token in the file. The firm is resolved at run time by lookup(registry_key)['firm'] and every address is opal_naming.address() output. Authored by 0.9.0_WK_IRPT_DASHBD~48 under IRPT_DASHBD.TO-DB-b-71; nothing here is served.

bd_z09.registry_key_comment: THE CUSTODY MASTER: the Black Diamond firm-instance prefix every account id of this firm carries (registry scopes.json class MASTER). It is the only identity this declaration carries.
bd_z09.account_form: the vendor's own AccountID string as landed (master prefix + digits), NOT zero-padded: this custodian issues no 10-char form
bd_z09.value_rule: V_t = the SUM of value_column over every holdings row of the account in partition t. Cash-equivalent rows are holdings rows and are inside the sum; the table carries no separate cash-balance column, so the whole-account value (C-VALUE) is this sum and a cash balance held outside the positions table, if any exists, is NOT in it (declared limit, measured in the record).
bd_z09.flow_sign_rule: capital-in positive, capital-out negative: the SIGNED amount column is summed over rows whose flow_column is one of flow_values. Measured on 20,179 deduplicated rows: Contribution positive on 99.94 percent, Withdrawal never positive.
bd_z09.flow_date_comment: The vendor's own performance date. Measured against a one-day lag on either side (Trade Date was not measured): the Return Date window (prev trading day, t] gives the smallest mean absolute daily return of the three (0.0156 against 0.0209 and 0.0258 at a one-day lag either way).
bd_z09.transaction_partition_comment: Transaction partitions are trailing-window snapshots, not cumulative; the union across partitions is deduplicated on transaction_key_column (latest partition wins). Measured: 994,900 landed rows, 96,423 distinct ids.
bd_z09.income_comment: Income on CASH RECEIPT over the same window as the flow (declared departure from GIPS accrual, as the contract states). Dividend Reinvestment is NOT admitted: it carries its own Income amount on the reinvestment leg and admitting it beside the Dividend row would count the same distribution twice.
bd_z09.large_flow_share_basis: held -- an offline placeholder, not the producer's measured p99; the producer MEASURES this threshold and this cell does not
bd_z09.history_scope_rule: PARTIAL_HISTORY for an account already present in the source's FIRST partition (its life began before the source's coverage); FULL for an account first seen later.
bd_z09.guard: NOT REACHED offline: holdings_price_return is null with reason NO_HOLDINGS_ROW and guard_state GUARD_NOT_REACHED on every row, because the IRPT_BCKEND price-only table is not read by this cell.
